cands.name: Elizabeth Holmes
cands.bio: Democrat, 42. Teaches English and exceptional student education at William T. Dwyer High School in Palm Beach Gardens; has worked for the Palm Beach County school district since 2011.
cands.local_ties: Teaches in Palm Beach Gardens; sheriff's records from 2003-2008 place her family at Wellington addresses (Florida Politics).

record.text: Has not held elected office. Platform: lower household costs, public education, protections against data centers and overdevelopment.

money_notes.text: Raised about $37,500 through Oct. 2 with about $10,000 left; far behind the incumbent.

controversies.text: A 2008 Palm Beach County Sheriff's report (case 08102866) says Holmes, then going by Elizabeth Thompson, threw a soda on a man at the Mall at Wellington Green and texted him an anti-gay slur and a threat; she told the deputy she sent the text. The man declined to prosecute and no charges were filed.

Mailers paid for by Citizens In Control cite 2003 and 2007 sheriff's reports (a stolen-credit-card complaint by her mother, and a 2007 arrest on misdemeanor battery and resisting without violence). Florida Politics describes the mailers and a booking sheet but the outcome of the 2007 case is not reported there.
Told students they could earn community service hours by sharing her campaign posts; the school district's Office of Professional Standards opened a file and closed it without finding a violation.

endorsements.text: Alex Vindman; SEIU Florida; Florida AFL-CIO; Palm Beach-Treasure Coast AFL-CIO; Palm Beach County Classroom Teachers Association; Emgage; Palm Beach County Human Rights Council.

cands.name: Megan Weinberger
cands.bio: Republican state representative for HD 94 since 2024. Runs Rescue Life, an animal sanctuary and adoption organization; Palm Beach County district lead for Moms for Liberty. Age 54.
cands.local_ties: Lives in Palm Beach Gardens; moved to Florida in 1979 (Wikipedia).

record.text: First term: passed a searchable database of convicted animal abusers, child-welfare measures, autism and autoimmune awareness days, a law replacing Gulf of Mexico with Gulf of America in state law, renaming Palm Beach International Airport for Donald Trump, and road designations honoring Trump and Charlie Kirk.

money_notes.text: Raised more than $675,000 across her campaign account and political committee since taking office, plus nearly $140,000 in in-kind help, much of it from the Republican Party; about $181,000 on hand before the final month.

endorsements.text: Donald Trump; Sen. Rick Scott; Reps. Brian Mast, Byron Donalds, Gus Bilirakis; Agriculture Commissioner Wilton Simpson; Belle Glade City Commission; Florida Chamber; Associated Industries of Florida; NRA Political Victory Fund; Palm Beach County PBA; Florida FOP.
